Title: SUPERVISED DEVELOPMENT WORKFLOW INTEGRATION
Summary: A SUPERVISED operator workflow integrating the existing DevBridge lifecycle, dependency context, AI recommendation, cost information and history systems into ONE coherent guided pipeline: Excel / governed task -> M03 task selection -> DB-M18.1 dependency development context -> M04 reservation -> M05 ChatGPT handoff -> AI recommendation / cost guidance -> HUMAN copies handoff to ChatGPT -> ChatGPT produces implementation prompt -> HUMAN copies prompt to Claude Code / DeepSeek -> implementation happens externally -> HUMAN returns implementation result -> M06 deterministic verification -> M07 Claude review package -> HUMAN sends package to Claude -> HUMAN records Claude decision -> M08 -> correction loop if required -> human Git gates in REAL mode -> governed completion. DB-M30 is a READ-ONLY presentation/guide engine over the 13-stage catalog (GOVERNED_TASK, M03_SELECTION, DEPENDENCY_CONTEXT, M04_RESERVATION, M05_CHATGPT_HANDOFF, AI_RECOMMENDATION_COST, EXTERNAL_IMPLEMENTATION, M06_VERIFICATION, M07_REVIEW_PACKAGE, M08_CLAUDE_DECISION, CORRECTION_LOOP, HUMAN_GIT_GATE, GOVERNED_COMPLETION) with the DevBridge.Engine 8-token vocabulary (NOT_STARTED/READY/CURRENT/PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/HUMAN_ACTION/NOT_APPLICABLE), five fault-isolated guidance cards (DependencyContext DB-M18.1, RoutingRecommendation DB-M19 dry-run gated on config/ai-routing.json routingDefaults.enabled, CostGuidance DB-M27/M21/M25, ProviderHealth DB-M22, History DB-M26/M29), a self-contained HTML renderer, a read-only guard (AutoExecutionEnabled=FALSE, paid 0, network 0, every *Modified=NO) and a secret-value scanner (free-text fields scanned, identifier/reference/hash/numeric fields exempt). DB-M30 NEVER advances the lifecycle, never executes a model/provider, never invokes ChatGPT/Claude Code/Claude, never creates/approves/merges PRs, never modifies the roadmap, never restores a baseline, never enables routing, never auto-advances -- every external step is a HUMAN_ACTION stage with the operator's exact instruction. Evidence is bound to the current task nodeId/changeId (a stale global artifact is warned, not counted). TRIAL mode truthfully marks HUMAN_GIT_GATE + GOVERNED_COMPLETION NOT_APPLICABLE (DB-M12.4 trial-cycle closure path replaces real completion). Live truth today (I38): node M-07-0.2 PREFLIGHTED -> M03 BLOCKED (preflight verdict NO_IMPLEMENTABLE_DESCENDANT; the container is NEVER the task), routing NOT_ENABLED (live gate closed), dependency context AVAILABLE, provider health EMPTY, history EMPTY (honest empty DB-M17 store).
